Kwame, I couldn't set up the daily digest. The scheduler rejected both the list and the create request with "gateway cron requires credentials," so nothing was scheduled and I can't confirm whether an automation already exists.

Here's what I confirmed:
- You're in #coastal-team, so I can read it for you.
- Tomorrow is Thursday 2026-10-15. The digest would run at 09:00 America/Chicago, your time zone, and cover new messages since the previous one.

The fix is on the Gateway side: its scheduler needs auth configured or this device paired. I'm not going to change Gateway auth myself. Once an operator has fixed it, tell me and I'll set up the digest. If you'd rather not wait, I can also post a digest of #coastal-team to you by hand whenever you ask.
